title: Grateful Dead Live at Manhattan Center on 1971-04-06

ai_review.summary: Clean soundboard capture of the April 6 1971 Manhattan Center show with a smoking Hog for You Baby, electric Dire Wolf and an unforgettable Pigpen‑driven Midnight Hour.
ai_review.review: The recording is a hi‑fi stereo soundboard mix that many reviewers note as cleaner than other copies, delivering crisp and balanced audio. Musically the performance shines – 24 songs flow together with high energy, highlighted by Hog for You Baby, Dire Wolf (electric), Oh Boy and a legendary midnight‑hour jam where Pigpen, Jerry and Bob lock in perfectly.

ai_rating.rationale: All three detailed reviews are 5‑star, praising both the exceptional soundboard quality and a high‑energy, standout performance; weighted rating yields a near‑excellent score.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hi‑Fi stereo soundboard mix praised as cleaner than other copies; crisp, clear balance with no reported dropouts or major flaws.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A marathon 24‑song set that moves smoothly, maintaining high momentum throughout; the second half builds to a powerful midnight‑hour climax.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Tight synch with Pigpen during the Midnight Hour, delivering seamless improvisation.
band_member_comments.Bob: In lockstep with Pigpen and Jerry, providing solid rhythm and vocal support.
band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen on organ in top form, driving the intensity of the midnight‑hour segment.
